Well, I mean... no, not really. Why would I? I'm telling you, I'm here because I keep hearing them. It's not my imagination. I hear the voices coming right out of the call-light speaker and those vents in the hallway. They tell me exactly which patient records have been changed. She always wanted me to join the choir, but I can't carry a tune in a bucket. Mark says I sound like a dying walrus when I sing in the shower. We just got our shower re-grouted, actually. He left a mess of dust all over the bathroom floor, though. I spent my whole Sunday on my hands and knees scrubbing it up. I have terrible knees, too. I think it's from being on my feet all day at the hospital. Nursing assistants do all the heavy lifting, you know. We're the ones turning the patients, helping them to the bathroom... it really takes a toll on your joints. I started taking this turmeric supplement I saw on TV, but I don't know if it's doing anything. The pills are huge, they always get stuck in my throat. 

But anyway, no, I don't think it's my mind playing tricks on me. The voices are real, they're coming right from the speakers and vents.

Well, I don't know if they'd stop. I mean, I'm here at the clinic right now, not at work, and I still keep hearing them. Like I told you, I'm here because I keep hearing voices from the call-light speaker and the hallway vents telling me which patient records have been changed.
